$comment: Engine profiles. Each profile is one Docker image (Playwright release => exact browser builds). `expected` versions come from playwright-core/browsers.json and the release notes (research: wpt-engines §3.2); `lcr setup` records the versions the container actually reports in env.json and reports print those. `lightningcss` maps an engine to the LightningCSS Browsers key used to decide whether an engine is inside a case's targets. Playwright WebKit is a WPE/GTK build, not Safari: treat it as Safari of the same WebKit version, minus Apple-only features. Legacy sets were chosen from BCD so that each lacks the features LightningCSS lowers (wpt-engines §3.3).

legacy-2023.lacks: nesting, lab/lch/oklab/oklch/color() and color-mix() in Chromium/Firefox, relative color, light-dark(), gradient interpolation spaces in Chromium/Firefox, :dir() in Chromium, round()/mod()/abs()/sign(), @scope, @starting-style, :has() and @container in Firefox

legacy-2021.lacks: everything legacy-2023 lacks, plus @layer, :has(), @container, dvh units in Chromium/Firefox, media range syntax in Chromium/WebKit, individual transforms in Chromium, color-mix() and :dir() in WebKit

legacy-2020.lacks: :is()/:where() and :not(a, b) in Chromium, logical shorthands, inset, aspect-ratio, system-ui in Firefox. Image is bionic with Node 12 and browsers under /root/.cache/ms-playwright: not supported by browsers.Dockerfile yet
